problem: The existing read-only live companion soak records N.E.K.O endpoint health plus desktop/backend process CPU/RSS, but it cannot attribute plugin child PID/RSS/CPU or detect plugin PID churn across a long idle/use soak. Those metrics are required for plugin restore latency/reliability and resource-leak diagnosis.

reuse_order.reason: Native status owns plugin liveness and exposes host-derived pid, exitcode and running/stopped/crashed/not_started without scanning process command lines.

reuse_order.result: identical to the current pin; no newer process-metrics surface is needed

reuse_order.layer: N.E.K.O Plugin SDK / PluginStore / native lifecycle
reuse_order.result: native plugin status is preferred over Plugin SDK self-reporting because the host must remain the process-liveness authority

reuse_order.asset: optional psutil already used by companion_runtime_soak.py
reuse_order.result: reuse psutil only to sample RSS/CPU for host-provided PIDs; no new process discovery authority
no new monitoring stack is justified for a local read-only soak; Prometheus/process-exporter style systems would add deployment/state complexity without improving host PID authority
extend the existing read-only soak to query /plugin/status, parse host PIDs, sample those exact PIDs with psutil, and summarize PID churn/RSS/CPU
reject runtime patch, daemon, watchdog, metrics service, state store or background collector

metrics: per-plugin RSS max and approximate CPU percent for stable PID
policy: PID must come from N.E.K.O native status, never inferred from arbitrary process command lines
optional fail-on-plugin-pid-churn may be used for controlled idle soak; default remains non-failing because intentional reload is valid
unavailable psutil or unavailable native status remains explicit evidence rather than fabricated zero values

retirement_condition: Retire the thin parsing/sampling extension if pinned N.E.K.O exposes equivalent long-soak process metrics directly or an existing accepted monitoring surface becomes the product authority.
